normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to carry the caller address into _transfer._transfer.
The to parameter is a local binding of the recipient and has no independent semantics outside _transfer.
The amount parameter is only meaningful as input to _transfer fee math.
contractTokenBalance is a transient value consumed directly by swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is a transient value consumed directly by sendETHToFee.
tokenAmount is the sole input of swapTokensForEth and maps to the router swap operation.
amount is the sole input of sendETHToFee and is divided between the fee wallets.
bots_ is only the iteration source for the setBots blacklist updates.
The loop counter i has no meaning outside the setBots loop.
tAmount is only the base value passed into _getValues by _transferStandard.
recipient is only forwarded from the public transfer into _transfer.
amount is only forwarded from the public transfer into _transfer.
sender is only forwarded from transferFrom into _transfer and the allowance read.
